subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, latest release behavior, and the merged policy PR intentionally keep key-free managed search explicit because it changes outbound provider routing.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the current policy and treat this issue as a diagnostics/setup guidance gap now that cron has a no-selected-provider warning.

options.title: Approve full keyless fallback
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only with matching runtime metadata, setup, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Leave the linked PR unmerged until the policy owner sponsors a specific provider-routing direction.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the current policy and treat this issue as a diagnostics/setup guidance gap now that cron has a no-selected-provider warning.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy this issue asks to reverse.
